capabilities.name: Controlled LLM Provider Evaluation Harness
capabilities.responsibility: Execute controlled evaluation cases against an injected LLM provider/model configuration, capture auditable execution traces, and attach deterministic evaluation without treating provider output as insurance truth.
capabilities.authority_role: Controlled evaluation execution infrastructure only; it records provider/model behaviour and cannot authorize production answer generation or override deterministic evaluation.
safety_invariants: Provider, model, model version, prompt version, parameters, timeout and run number remain explicit in each controlled execution.
Timeouts, provider errors and unexpected exceptions are captured as governed execution statuses rather than converted into successful outputs.
Every completed controlled case is evaluated by the deterministic LLM evaluator before an EvaluationOutput is returned.
capabilities.notes: Provider-neutral Protocol/injected adapter boundary. Concrete local API-key configuration is intentionally outside repository authority.

capabilities.name: Deterministic LLM Output Evaluator
capabilities.responsibility: Evaluate controlled LLM outputs reproducibly against governed semantic requirements and forbidden behaviours using deterministic lexical, numeric, scope, citation, abstention and safety checks.
capabilities.authority_role: Authoritative baseline evaluator within MO-022F controlled experiments; external metrics may inform review but do not replace this verdict.
safety_invariants: Non-completed provider executions are NOT_EVALUATED rather than treated as passes.
Missing governed requirements and detected forbidden behaviours produce deterministic failure codes.
Unsupported recommendation, certainty inflation, claim-payment prediction, citation mismatch and numerical alteration are explicit failure classes.
capabilities.notes: A bounded experiment evaluator, not semantic proof for arbitrary production prose.

capabilities.name: External Metric Advisory Evaluation
capabilities.responsibility: Run bounded injectable external evaluation metrics such as DeepEval-compatible or HHEM-compatible experiments and return advisory metric evidence without changing deterministic verdict authority.
capabilities.authority_role: Advisory experimental signal only; dependency failure, timeout, inconclusive results or metric scores cannot override deterministic evaluation.
safety_invariants: External metric results remain advisory and never mutate deterministic findings.
Optional metric dependencies and judge models are injected rather than silently imported as production requirements.
Metric failures and unavailable dependencies fail into explicit ERROR or INCONCLUSIVE evidence.
capabilities.notes: Experimental evaluation support; not production answer authority.

capabilities.name: Deterministic and External Evaluation Disagreement Analysis
capabilities.responsibility: Classify agreement, conflict and inconclusive states between authoritative deterministic LLM-evaluation verdicts and advisory external metric results for review and model-comparison evidence.
capabilities.authority_role: Comparison and review evidence only; the deterministic verdict remains unchanged and authoritative in every disagreement category.
safety_invariants: Case and trace identity must match across deterministic and external evidence.
Disagreement analysis never reruns evaluators or changes either source result.
Conflicting or inconclusive external evidence requires review rather than silently promoting external authority.
capabilities.notes: Existing disagreement/comparison capability that must be checked before proposing another LLM-output comparison framework.

capabilities.name: Bounded LLM Responsibility Decision Reporting
capabilities.responsibility: Aggregate controlled evaluation cases, deterministic verdicts and disagreement evidence into conservative responsibility-status reports for review.
capabilities.authority_role: Produces controlled-evaluation decision evidence only; it does not enable an LLM responsibility, authorize production use or mutate underlying evaluation results.
safety_invariants: Any deterministic failure rejects the reviewed responsibility.
Review-required, not-evaluated, conflicting or inconclusive evidence cannot become unconditional approval.
APPROVED_WITH_DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION retains deterministic validation as an explicit required control.
capabilities.notes: A responsibility report is evidence about controlled use, not a runtime authorization token.

capabilities.name: Deterministic versus LLM Rendering Baseline Comparison
capabilities.responsibility: Compare deterministic explanation text with released or fallback hybrid-rendering text across scenarios, recording wording changes, readability signals, fidelity outcomes, provider failures and fallback rates.
capabilities.authority_role: Measurement and comparison only; it evaluates hybrid-rendering behaviour but does not release customer text or alter rendering safety authority.
safety_invariants: Released section coverage must match deterministic section coverage for non-fallback cases.
Fallback cases are evaluated against deterministic source text rather than treated as missing outputs.
Readability improvement metrics do not override fidelity or deterministic safety controls.
capabilities.notes: Existing LLM-output comparison/baseline capability intended for reuse in controlled rendering experiments.
